mustFindings.requirement: No double hold of a seat
At most 4 seats per hold request

mustScenarios.risk: Two customers try to hold the same seat; exactly one succeeds and the other gets ErrSeatTaken
A hold stops blocking the seat once 10 minutes have passed
A request for 5 seats is rejected
One of several requested seats is taken: no seat of that request stays held (transaction rolls back)

secondOrder.risk: A customer completes payment after their hold has already expired.
A second customer holds the seat after the first hold expired, and then the first customer's payment arrives.
A customer requests a hold on a seat they already hold.
A hold succeeds but the response is lost and the customer's client sends the identical request again.
A hold request that lists no seats.
One hold request lists the same seat twice.
Two customers hold the same seat number for two different shows.

forbidden.description: Payment capture and refunds are not part of this change

notes: Everything is implemented. A report that marks a requirement missing or contradicted is wrong here.
